ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) with high-intensity (white) pixels comprising approximately 10-15% of the total surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark-intensity field across the ventral surface. High-contrast white linear streaks concentrated on the medial-left lobe. Dense circular high-intensity clusters localized at the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a narrow acute angle at the central vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-serrations with low pixel-amplitude along the entire continuous trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinctly concave curve along the upper boundary trailing from the median notch toward the uplifted distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly dense clusters of white circular pixel groups (barnacle colonies) at the distal tips of both lobes; scattered circular white pits (healed scars) across the dark surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous vertical and diagonal white linear streaks (rake marks) distributed across the fluke, with highest density and length observed on the interior left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring characterized by white linear rake marks and circular depigmented spots across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced, multi-layered calcified white barnacle clusters protruding from the extreme edges of the distal tips.
